GENERAL.TITLE: General data of the agreement
GENERAL.WHAT: The identity card of the agreement between the provider and the payer: who signs it, for how long, under which plan and how much budget it has.
GENERAL.WHY: When an account arrives, the provider name finds this agreement, so every check uses its rules. The execution bars show how much of the budget is used.
GENERAL.HOW: Use the pencil to edit the data and the aliases (other names the provider uses on invoices). Add key contacts with «New contact». Save to keep the changes.

CHECKLIST.TITLE: Documentary checklist
CHECKLIST.WHAT: The list of documents each account of this agreement must bring: invoice, admission sheet, authorization… Each row is a rule with its risk if the document is missing.
CHECKLIST.WHY: Before radication, the screen and the pre-analysis agent compare the delivered documents with this list and point out what is missing, so the payer does not reject the account.
CHECKLIST.HOW: Filter by risk or by document, then «Edit» to add, change or disable rules. A condition in words (e.g. «surgery billed») makes the rule apply only in that case.

POLICY.TITLE: Pre-analysis policy
POLICY.WHAT: The instructions the pre-analysis agent follows: which profile applies (one invoice or several), which documents and which cross-checks it must verify.
POLICY.WHY: It turns the checklist into a review an auditor would do: same patient in every document, same invoice number, dates within the stay.
POLICY.HOW: Edit each profile: required and conditional documents (they must exist in the checklist) and the cross-checks. The agent reads the saved version.

AGENT_FINANCIAL.TITLE: Tariffs (Financial Variance)
AGENT_FINANCIAL.WHAT: The agreed price of each service, with the allowed variance and whether it needs authorization.
AGENT_FINANCIAL.WHY: The Financial Variance agent compares each billed line with this table and flags amounts outside the range before the payer does.
AGENT_FINANCIAL.HOW: Edit to change amounts or add services, or ask the AI assistant («the tariff of 890201 is RD$ 2,800»).

AGENT_COMPLIANCE.TITLE: Payer compliance (Compliance Alert)
AGENT_COMPLIANCE.WHAT: Payer conditions: which services need prior authorization, from which amount, and which supports they require.
AGENT_COMPLIANCE.WHY: The Compliance Alert agent warns when an account breaks one of these conditions, for example a surgery above the threshold without authorization.
AGENT_COMPLIANCE.HOW: Edit the rules or write one to the AI assistant («surgeries above RD$ 80,000 require prior authorization»).

AGENT_CODING.TITLE: Coding (Coding Integrity)
AGENT_CODING.WHAT: Coding rules: codes that cannot be billed together, services included in a package and diagnoses each procedure needs.
AGENT_CODING.WHY: The Coding Integrity agent detects incompatible or unbundled codes, a frequent cause of payer objections.
AGENT_CODING.HOW: Edit the payer policy or the coding rules, or ask the AI assistant («99213 is not billed together with 99214»).

DOCUMENTS.TITLE: Contract and annexes
DOCUMENTS.WHAT: The signed contract and its annexes (tariffs, manuals) of this agreement.
DOCUMENTS.WHY: They are the source of the rules: anyone can open them, check their validity and ask Knowledge Discovery what the contract says.
DOCUMENTS.HOW: Choose the type and validity, then «Upload or attach». Files go to the agreement's contract folder and «View» opens them. To ask the contract, use the floating Knowledge Discovery agent: it opens the agreement's agent in a new tab, and its gear sets the link.

AI_RULES.TITLE: AI rules
AI_RULES.WHAT: The checks the AI agents run on every account of this agreement, and how strict they are: which validations are on, the confidence an account needs to pass without manual review and how much a price may differ from the agreed tariff.
AI_RULES.WHY: Each payer accepts a different level of risk. Tuning these values per agreement balances speed (more accounts approved automatically) against control (more accounts reviewed by a person), and the history shows who changed what and when.
AI_RULES.HOW: Turn validations on or off, move the sliders and save. Every saved change is logged with date, user and before/after values. In this demo the agents do not read these values yet: they document the decision policy of the agreement.

AI.TITLE: AI rules
AI.LEAD: Which validations the agents apply to this agreement and the thresholds of their decisions. Every save is logged in the history.
AI.NOT_WIRED: The Automate agents do not read these values yet: they are the configuration of the agreement, ready to be connected to the agents.
AI.VALIDATIONS_LEAD: Turn each check on or off for this agreement.
AI.THRESHOLD_CONFIDENCE_HINT: Accounts above this confidence pass without manual review, as long as no hard rule fails.
AI.THRESHOLD_SENSITIVITY_HINT: Higher sensitivity flags more unusual accounts for review; lower sensitivity flags only clear anomalies.
AI.THRESHOLD_VARIANCE_HINT: How much a billed amount may differ from the agreed tariff before it is flagged. Each tariff row keeps its own tolerance in the tariff agreement.
AI.TARIFF_NONE: The tariff agreement has no default tolerance.
AI.TARIFF_IN_SYNC: Same as the default tolerance of the tariff agreement ({{value}}%).
AI.TARIFF_DIFFERS: The tariff agreement uses {{value}}% by default. Saving here does not change the tariff agreement.
AI.HISTORY_LEAD: Logged automatically when the AI rules or a rules file of this agreement is saved. Last 100 changes.

APPROVAL.TITLE: Approval Phase
APPROVAL.DESCRIPTION: Finalize the billing package, verify validated claims, and select the target transmission format.

EXECUTION.TITLE: Execution Phase
EXECUTION.DESCRIPTION: Generate clinical justifications and send traceable appeal packages for denied claims.

REVIEW.TITLE: Final Review & Audit Phase
REVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Review finalized claims and verify reconciliation metrics for the active cycle.

COMPLETED.TITLE: Completed Phase
COMPLETED.DESCRIPTION: Close reconciled accounts, track recovered value, and update the billing intelligence loop.
